info.name: EZ Key Public admin
info.description:
Unauthenticated Admin API endpoints intended for the Admin UI login shell, operators, and QA.

## Endpoints

- **Get public instance info**: Read-only metadata (`instanceName`, `instanceDescription`, `aboutUrl`, `authApiPublicBaseUrl`)

## Authentication

**No Bearer token.** No `Authorization` header. These routes are `permitAll` in Spring Security.

## Relationship to enrollment QR

`authApiPublicBaseUrl` mirrors the value configured as `ezkey.qr.auth-base-url` on the Admin API — the same string embedded as `authUrl` in enrollment QR JSON when that property is set. Use this request to verify what the server will expose before scanning QR codes on a device.

## Environment

Use the same `{{base_url_admin_api}}` variable as other Admin API collections (see `postman/environments/local.postman_environment.json`).

request.description:
Returns read-only instance metadata for branding and operator visibility.

**No authentication required.**

**Response (200 OK):**
- `instanceName` (string): from `ezkey.organization.name`
- `instanceDescription` (string): from `ezkey.organization.description`
- `aboutUrl` (string | null): from `ezkey.organization.about-url` when set
- `authApiPublicBaseUrl` (string | null): from `ezkey.qr.auth-base-url`; same value as `authUrl` in enrollment QR JSON when configured

**Status codes:**
- 200: OK
- 500: Internal server error
